mapper.select: SELECT user_card_id AS userCardId, member_id AS memberId, card_id AS cardId, masked_card_number AS maskedCardNumber, is_representative AS representative, card_status AS cardStatus FROM user_card WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND card_id = #{cardId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_card SET masked_card_number = #{maskedCardNumber}, card_status = 'ACTIVE', is_representative = 0, registered_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND card_status = 'DELETED'
mapper.select: SELECT uc.user_card_id AS userCardId, c.card_name AS cardName, cc.company_name AS companyName, uc.masked_card_number AS maskedCardNumber, c.image_url AS imageUrl, uc.is_representative AS representative FROM user_card uc INNER JOIN card c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id INNER JOIN card_company cc ON cc.card_company_id = c.card_company_id WHERE uc.member_id = #{memberId} AND uc.card_id = #{cardId} AND uc.card_status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.is_active = 'Y' AND cc.is_active = 'Y' LIMIT 1

SELECT uc.user_card_id AS userCardId, uc.card_id AS cardId, c.card_name AS cardName, cc.company_name AS issuerName, c.card_type AS cardType, uc.masked_card_number AS maskedCardNumber, c.image_url AS imageUrl, uc.is_representative AS representative, uc.registered_at AS registeredAt FROM user_card uc INNER JOIN card c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id INNER JOIN card_company cc ON cc.card_company_id = c.card_company_id WHERE uc.member_id = #{memberId} AND uc.card_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY uc.registered_at DESC, uc.user_card_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_card SET card_status = 'DELETED', is_representative = 0 WHERE user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND card_status = 'ACTIVE'
